verdict.rationale: AMD ships a real NPU with a working SDK/runtime today (Ryzen AI Software, ONNX Runtime + Vitis AI EP, Lemonade SDK, GAIA agent framework, xrt-smi tooling, hybrid/NPU-only execution modes) and community reports confirm real local LLM inference on the hardware. However, no published TOPS figure with precision stated appears anywhere in the evidence pack for this chip's NPU. missing for 10: an official TOPS number with precision (e.g., INT8/BF16) for the Ryzen AI Max+ 395 NPU, and independent benchmark corroboration of NPU throughput matching that spec.
